callerAuthority.host: Actual main Webview, fixed shell document and native document generation, authorized by the existing connection authority
callerAuthority.reader: Actual backend-created target Webview, fixed packaged Reader document and native target document generation
callerAuthority.launchId: Lookup only; never a bearer permission
callerAuthority.claimToken: Issued only after actual target caller validation; never persisted

hostAuthFields.leaseToken: Existing active source lease; must not be reconstructed or persisted

source.entryRevision: Exact saved entry revision, rechecked from the host repository
source.libraryBaseUrl: Canonical original full library base from the existing base-url parser

resource.effectiveBaseUrl: Effective resource library base, preserving the library path prefix
resource.revision: string or null for the existing fixed legacy resource route

reservation.documentGeneration: Actual target Reader document generation, zero before binding

moke_reader_check.terminalObservation: The same owner may observe its terminal record with the old lease; this does not authorize a new request or restore an active source

moke_reader_open.targetAuthority: Backend chooses the label and fixed Reader document; create or navigation failure revokes the reservation

moke_reader_claim.requiredBefore: The first Reader resource request or progress restore

moke_reader_resource_dispatch.urlAuthority: Exact sealed current-book resource URL only
moke_reader_resource_dispatch.requiredBefore: Every Reader HTTP request for the sealed resource

moke_reader_resource_settle.requires: The same launch and actual Reader document; real response EOF or confirmed cancellation terminal state, followed by the settle IPC ACK

moke:reader-progress.meaning: Wake hint; host must take the authoritative payload

moke:reader-closing.meaning: Wake hint; host must check authoritative phase and sequence before draining

moke:reader-drain-ready.meaning: Wake hint after closing progress and existing HTTP tickets settle without unknown; Reader must call closing with the same claim and final sequence to observe the authoritative terminal result
moke:reader-drain-ready.emitFailure: Mark the Reader lifecycle unknown without turning an already successful original ticket settle ACK into a failure or replay

progressIdentity.emptyNamespaceMigration: Preserve originals; never infer ownership from the current library
progressIdentity.restoreConflictPolicy: For the same original full base and book, valid local progress wins unless both timestamps are valid explicit-timezone ISO dates and the remote timestamp is strictly newer; reread the same source local key after the remote response

progressPayload.moke_book_id: Must equal the reserved book ID string

completion.complete: Observed operation completed with an explicit completion result
completion.failed: Observed operation received a definite failure result
completion.unknown: Completion is unconfirmed; do not release native occupancy or replay a mutation
returnedRequires: all accepted local and remote progress writes settled

sessionRevocation.hostStoreSubscription: bindReaderSourceLifecycle observes source, saved entry revision, session revision, offline and connection changes, then invokes the tracked revokeStaleSources once with each old captured lease

nativeBeforeHttpPermit.routeBase: Exact routes below the original full library base
nativeBeforeHttpPermit.effect: Synchronously revoke the old Reader generation before an authentication request can change the cookie jar

errors.reader_unsupported: The actual packaged Reader does not declare the complete capability group or compatible embed/progress schema
errors.unsupported: The actual platform is outside the current native authority support
errors.reader_busy: A Reader lease or bounded pending progress queue is still occupied
errors.reader_invalid_launch: The launch lookup or owner document/session/epoch does not match
errors.reader_invalid_book: The current book ID is outside the accepted numeric ID contract
errors.reader_invalid_phase: The requested transition is not valid for this launch phase
errors.reader_invalid_resource: The current resource URL, base, book, revision or metadata does not match the sealed contract
errors.reader_wrong_document: The actual Webview, exact fixed document or target document generation is not the bound Reader
errors.reader_invalid_claim: The claim does not match this bound document or lifecycle phase
errors.reader_sequence_invalid: Progress sequence or final sequence is missing, out of order, repeated or inconsistent
errors.reader_progress_invalid: The progress wire, book identity, fields or size is invalid
errors.reader_window_failed: Window creation failed after native preparation; completion remains unknown
errors.reader_relay_unknown: Native relay notification could not be confirmed; completion remains unknown
errors.reader_launch_unknown: The launch lifecycle is unconfirmed; do not replay or release it
errors.inherited: Existing connection-authority source/document/entry/epoch/lease and IO errors remain authoritative

requiredReaderHooks: claim before resource use or restore
resource settle after real EOF or confirmed cancellation terminal state and native ACK
closing with authoritative final sequence and terminal observation
consumerStatus.legacyEmbeddedProductionEntry: requireHostBoundReaderLaunch remains closed until the host intentionally switches to the new launch controller after Reader integration
consumerStatus.readerStage: TB-456 remains backlog until the coordinator accepts the actual host delivery
